plan.major: Games and Interactive Media with Concentration in Digital Media
plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.213-215.

courses.title: Art / Design courses (choose at least two)
courses.choice_note: Choose at least two of these courses, 8 credits as printed: ART 1200 Creative Ideation with Drawing & Design; ART 1310 3-D Foundations; ART 1502 Painting I: Representation & Color Theory; ART 2602 Graphic Design; ART 3210 Animation, Avatars & Environment; ART 3602 Graphic Design II; ART 3610 Game Aesthetics Seminar (2 hours); ART 3620 Game Aesthetics Studio (2 hours).

courses.title: Professional / Communication course (choose at least one)
courses.choice_note: Choose at least one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: CLD 3100 Experiencing Career & Life Directions (2 hours); ECM 2310 Improving Conversation & Communication; ECM 2410 Student Publications Practicum (1-2 hours; may repeat to total 2 hours); ECM 2440 Successful Communication at Work; ECM 2740 Communications Practicum (1-2 hours; may repeat to total 2 hours); ECM 3800 Internship (1-2 hours); THE 2010 Public Speaking; THE 2050 Introduction to Acting.

courses.title: Grammar / Communication course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: ECM 2300 Grammar and Linguistics; ECM 2310 Improving Conversation and Communication.

courses.title: Media Writing / Creative courses (choose three)
courses.choice_note: Choose three of these courses, 12 credits as printed: ECM 2400 Media Writing & Ethics; ECM 2450 Introduction to Creative Writing; ECM 2480 Screenwriting; ECM 2600 Media & Culture; ECM 2830 Social Media & Reputation Management; ECM 2840 Sports & Media; THE 2110 Playwriting.

courses.title: Media Production course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: ECM 2700 Media Production; ECM 2720 Podcasting; ECM 3720 Digital Videography.

courses.title: Games courses (choose at least four)
courses.choice_note: Choose at least 4 of these courses, 16 credits as printed: GAM 1200 Games & Play; GAM 1310 Introduction to Esports; GAM 1400 Exploring Game Design; GAM 2220 Games & Society; GAM 2230 Controversies in Gaming; GAM 2250 Game Storytelling & Narrative; GAM 2270 Game Journalism; GAM 2280 Game Studio (1-4 hours; may repeat to total 4 hours); GAM 2520 Gamers, Players, & Fans; GAM 2830 Legendary Game Designers; GAM 2940 Gaming Ecosystems; GAM 3410 Linear Level Design in Games; GAM 3550 Interactive Narratives & Games; GAM 3600 Special Topics in Game Design & Development.

courses.title: Related course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: BUS 1100 Introduction to Business; BUS 2002 Organizational Behavior & Management; BUS 2003 Marketing; BUS 2720 Descriptive Business Analytics; DAT 1200 Data Wrangling; ECO 2200 Principles of Microeconomics; MAT 1080 Introduction to the Mathematics of Computer Graphics.

courses.title: Related course (choose one)
courses.choice_note: Choose one of these courses, 4 credits as printed: KIN 1100 Personal Fitness & Wellness; KIN 2300 Motor Behavior; KIN 3330 Psychological Aspects of Exercise & Sports; KIN 3340 Socio-cultural Foundation in Exercise & Sport; KIN 3360 Let's Build a Sports Organization; PSY 1100 General Psychology; PSY 2100 Developmental Psychology; PSY 2510 Health Psychology.
